title: Zesty Smoky Peruvian Sea Bass Ceviche Clasico
description: A sweet and shattering solo dinner Peruvian dish featuring hot smoked paprika, wood fired bake, and egg free friendly ingredients, served as a ceviche clasico in a molcajete vessel.
instructions: Preheat the wood fired oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Season the sea bass fillets with salt, black pepper, and hot smoked paprika.
Bake the sea bass fillets in the wood fired oven for 8 minutes or until cooked through.
Chill the cooked sea bass fillets in the refrigerator for 30 minutes.
Cut the chilled sea bass fillets into small pieces and place them in a molcajete vessel.
Mix in the fresh lime juice, mixed color onions, aji amarillo peppers, fresh cilantro, and garlic.
Stir well to combine and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Cover the molcajete vessel with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 10 minutes to allow the flavors to meld.
Serve the Zesty Smoky Peruvian Sea Bass Ceviche Clasico chilled, garnished with additional fresh cilantro if desired.
